correctness.rationale: All hypotheses and normalization are defined. The cycle adjacency has binary radical span(all ones), so commuting contexts have no Pauli-product dependency. The explicit odd-hole stable-set inequalities follow from an integral-vertex argument. The resulting symmetric gauge equals the signed affine coefficient l1 minimum with floor 1. Two anticommuting Pauli observables give exactly sqrt(2); every irreducible central sector of the odd-cycle Pauli algebra is a signed canonical Majorana cycle, whose skew circulant mode spectrum gives cot(pi/(2L)). Strict concavity and endpoint inequalities establish the unique C11 transition. The packaged symbolic C5 exact characteristic checks, direct matrix checks through C17, and independent LP tests were actually run.

value.rationale: Odd holes are the minimal forbidden nonperfect family for the motivating sharp perfect-frustration-graph magic-witness theorem. A quantitative all-length classification on these graphs distinguishes the new odd-hole resource facet from pairwise uncertainty, provides sharp physical capacity/attaining states, and identifies a finite nontrivial transition at eleven observables. This fills a motivated precise gap rather than arbitrarily fixing a case; it does not claim novelty for established polytope facets or free-fermion technology.
